title: Origins of Madhubani Art
content: Madhubani painting originated in the Mithila region of Bihar and was traditionally practiced by women on mud walls and floors during festivals and special occasions.
summary: Brief overview of Madhubani art origins

title: Madhubani Painting Techniques
content: Madhubani art uses natural dyes and pigments and is characterized by geometric patterns line drawings and vibrant use of colors filled within double outlined figures.
summary: Overview of core Madhubani painting techniques
